deadlines.label: UCAS deadline (Loughborough undergraduate courses)
deadlines.notes: 18:00 UK time. UCAS equal-consideration date for 2027 entry; applications after it are not guaranteed equal consideration.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Everyone applying must hold an English language qualification, whether or not English is their first language. School-based qualifications are accepted if taken within 10 years (e.g. GCSE or O Level English Language grade C / 4); the course page says English studied within certain country qualifications is normally sufficient. Medium of instruction letters are not accepted.

english.notes: IELTS Academic (incl. Online and One Skill Retake), university standard. A few other courses (e.g. BA Politics, Philosophy and Economics, LLB Law, Psychology and Sport Science courses) need a higher level. Tests must be no more than 2 years old.
Tests taken before 21 January 2026 (0-120 scale); at least 21 in each test.
Tests taken from 21 January 2026 (1-6 scale): 4.5 overall, at least 4.5 in Writing and Listening and at least 4.0 in Speaking and Reading.
Pearson Test of Academic English (centre-based test): 65 overall, not less than 61 in each sub-test.
Overall 120 with the stated minimum in each integrated and individual sub-test.

tier_notes.general: Complete University Guide 2027 overall ranking: 8th of 130 UK universities (A = ranks 6-15 on the national scale).
